analyst: April, the Cyber Threat Intelligence (CTI) Lead
industry: genomics, life sciences, and precision manufacturing
strategic_profile: Mid market manufacturer of benchtop DNA sequencing instruments and cloud analysis software; core platforms are HelixSeq X, HelixSeq Lite, and HelixSeq Micro.

Cloud platforms hold customer genomic and clinical data: GeneLabs Connected Analytics (GCA) and SeqSpace Sequence Hub, with RAPIDCALL secondary analysis pipelines. These are the crown jewel data assets and the primary exfiltration targets.
Custodian of human genomic data, which makes the company a high value target for intellectual property theft and espionage against biotechnology and precision medicine.
International manufacturing and distribution footprint, creating export control and geopolitical exposure in several markets.
Extensive third party and supply chain footprint across instruments, reagents, and laboratory software, creating supply chain compromise exposure.
Operates in a regulated clinical environment; genomic data privacy and cross border data access legislation directly affects the business.
